name: YIELDMAT
description: Returns the annual yield of a security that pays interest at maturity.

name: YIELDDISC
description: Returns the annual yield for a discounted security.

name: YEARFRAC
description: Returns the fraction of the year represented by the number of whole days between two dates.

name: YEAR
description: Returns the year corresponding to a date.

name: XOR
description: Returns TRUE when an odd number of arguments are TRUE.

name: XNPV
description: Returns the net present value for a schedule of cash flows that is not necessarily periodic.

name: XIRR
description: Returns the internal rate of return for a schedule of cash flows that is not necessarily periodic.

name: WEIBULL
description: Returns the Weibull distribution.

name: WEIBULL.DIST
description: Returns the Weibull distribution.

name: WEEKDAY
description: Returns the day of the week corresponding to a date, typically 1 (Sunday) through 7 (Saturday) depending on return_type.

name: VLOOKUP
description: Looks for a value in the first column of a table and returns a value in the same row from the column you specify.

name: VARP
description: Calculates variance based on the entire population.

name: VAR.S
description: Estimates variance based on a sample.

name: VAR.P
description: Calculates variance based on the entire population.

name: VAR
description: Estimates variance based on a sample.

name: VALUE
description: Converts a text string that represents a number into a number.

name: USDOLLAR
description: Converts a number to text using US dollar currency format. Legacy alias of DOLLAR.

name: UPPER
description: Converts text to uppercase.

name: TYPE
description: Returns a number indicating the data type of a value.

name: TRUNC
description: Truncates a number to an integer by removing the fractional part, or to a given number of digits.

name: TRUE
description: Returns the logical value TRUE.

name: TRIMMEAN
description: Returns the mean of the interior of a data set, excluding a percentage of points from the top and bottom.

name: TRIM
description: Removes extra spaces from text, leaving single spaces between words.

name: TODAY
description: Returns the current date as a serial number. The value updates when the worksheet is recalculated or opened.

name: TIME
description: Returns the decimal number for a particular time.

name: TEXTJOIN
description: Joins text from multiple ranges or strings using a delimiter, optionally ignoring empty values.

name: TEXT
description: Formats a number and converts it to text using the given number-format code (e.g. "0.00%", "yyyy-mm-dd").

name: TBILLYIELD
description: Returns the yield for a Treasury bill given settlement, maturity and price/discount.

name: TBILLPRICE
description: Returns the price per $100 face value for a Treasury bill given settlement, maturity and discount.

name: TBILLEQ
description: Returns the bond-equivalent yield for a Treasury bill.

name: TANH
description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a number.

name: TAN
description: Returns the tangent of a given angle (in radians).

name: T
description: Returns the text referred to by value, or empty text if the value is not text.

name: SYD
description: Returns the sum-of-years' digits depreciation of an asset for a specified period.

name: SWITCH
description: evaluates one value (called the expression) against a list of values, and returns the result corresponding to the first matching value. If there is no match, an optional default value may be returned.

name: SUMXMY2
description: Returns the sum of squares of the differences of corresponding values in two arrays.

name: SUMX2PY2
description: Returns the sum of the sums of squares of corresponding values in two arrays.

name: SUMX2MY2
description: Returns the sum of the differences of squares of corresponding values in two arrays.

name: SUMSQ
description: Returns the sum of the squares of the supplied arguments.

name: SUMPRODUCT
description: Multiplies corresponding components in the given arrays and returns the sum of those products.

name: SUMIFS
description: Adds the cells in a range that meet multiple criteria.

name: SUMIF
description: Adds the cells specified by a given condition or criteria.

name: SUM
description: Adds all the numbers in a range of cells.

name: SUBTOTAL
description: Returns a subtotal of a list or range, using the aggregate function chosen by function_num.

name: SUBSTITUTE
description: Replaces occurrences of old text with new text in a string; optionally only the nth occurrence.

name: STDEVP
description: Calculates the standard deviation based on the entire population.

name: STDEV.S
description: Estimates the standard deviation based on a sample.

name: STDEV.P
description: Calculates the standard deviation based on the entire population.

name: STDEV
description: Estimates the standard deviation based on a sample.

name: STANDARDIZE
description: Returns a normalized value from a distribution characterized by a mean and standard deviation.

name: SQRTPI
description: Returns the square root of pi times a number.

name: SQRT
description: Returns the positive square root of a number.

name: SMALL
description: Returns the k-th smallest value in a data set.

name: SLOPE
description: Returns the slope of the linear regression line through the given data points.

name: SLN
description: Returns the straight-line depreciation of an asset for one period.

name: SKEW.P
description: Returns the skewness of a distribution, based on the entire population.

name: SKEW
description: Returns the skewness of a distribution, based on a sample.

name: SINH
description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a number.

name: SIN
description: Returns the sine of the given angle (in radians).

name: SIGN
description: Returns the sign of a number: 1 (positive), 0 (zero), or -1 (negative).

name: SECOND
description: Returns the seconds of a time value, a number from 0 to 59.

name: SEARCHB
description: Returns the position, in bytes, of one text string within another (not case-sensitive).

name: SEARCH
description: Returns the position of one text string within another (case-insensitive).

name: RSQ
description: Returns the square of the Pearson correlation coefficient through the given data points.

name: RRI
description: Returns the equivalent interest rate for the growth of an investment.

name: ROWS
description: Returns the number of rows in a reference or array.

name: ROW
description: Returns the row number of a reference. If omitted, returns the row number of the cell containing the formula.

args.description: Optional. The reference from which to return the row number.

name: ROUNDUP
description: Rounds a number up, away from zero, to the given number of digits.

name: ROUNDDOWN
description: Rounds a number down, toward zero, to the given number of digits.

name: ROUND
description: Rounds a number to a specified number of digits.

name: RIGHTB
description: Returns the last character or characters in a text string, based on the number of bytes you specify.

name: RIGHT
description: Returns the last character or characters in a text string, based on the number of characters you specify.

name: REPT
description: Repeats text a given number of times.

name: REPLACEB
description: Replaces part of a text string, based on the number of bytes you specify, with a different text string.

name: REPLACE
description: Replaces part of a text string, based on the number of characters you specify, with another string.

name: REGEXTEST
description: Checks whether any part of the text matches the given regular expression pattern, returning TRUE or FALSE.

name: REGEXREPLACE
description: Replaces text in a string that matches a regular expression pattern with the given replacement.

name: REGEXEXTRACT
description: Extracts text from a string that matches a regular expression pattern.

name: RECEIVED
description: Returns the amount received at maturity for a fully invested security.

name: RATE
description: Returns the interest rate per period of an annuity.

name: RANK
description: Returns the rank of a number in a list of numbers (ties averaged in older Excel versions).

name: RANK.EQ
description: Returns the rank of a number in a list of numbers; if more than one value has the same rank, the top rank of that set is returned.

name: RANK.AVG
description: Returns the rank of a number in a list of numbers; if several values share a rank, the average rank is returned.

name: RANDBETWEEN
description: Returns a random integer between the numbers you specify.

name: RAND
description: Returns an evenly distributed random real number greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1.

name: RADIANS
description: Converts degrees to radians.

name: QUOTIENT
description: Returns the integer portion of a division.

name: QUARTILE
description: Returns the quartile of a data set.

name: QUARTILE.INC
description: Returns the quartile of a data set, based on percentile values from 0 to 1, inclusive.

name: PV
description: Calculates the present value of an investment based on periodic, constant payments and a constant interest rate.

name: PROPER
description: Capitalizes the first letter of each word in a text string and lowercases the rest.

name: PRODUCT
description: Multiplies all the numbers given as arguments and returns the product.

name: PRICEMAT
description: Returns the price per $100 face value of a security that pays interest at maturity.

name: PRICEDISC
description: Returns the price per $100 face value of a discounted security.

name: PRICE
description: Returns the price per $100 face value of a security that pays periodic interest.

name: PPMT
description: Returns the payment on the principal for a given period for an investment.

name: POWER
description: Returns the result of a number raised to a power.

name: POISSON
description: Returns the Poisson distribution.

name: POISSON.DIST
description: Returns the Poisson distribution.

name: PMT
description: Calculates the payment for a loan based on constant payments and a constant interest rate.

name: PI
description: Returns the number 3.14159265358979, the mathematical constant pi, accurate to 15 digits.

name: PERMUT
description: Returns the number of permutations for a given number of objects (ordered arrangements).

name: PERCENTRANK
description: Returns the rank of a value in a data set as a percentage of the data set.

name: PERCENTRANK.INC
description: Returns the rank of a value in a data set as a percentage (0 to 1, inclusive) of the data set.

name: PERCENTILE
description: Returns the k-th percentile of values in a range.

name: PERCENTILE.INC
description: Returns the k-th percentile of values in a range, where k is in the range 0 to 1, inclusive.

name: PEARSON
description: Returns the Pearson product moment correlation coefficient.

name: PDURATION
description: Returns the number of periods required by an investment to reach a specified value.

name: OR
description: Returns TRUE if any argument is TRUE; returns FALSE if all arguments are FALSE.

name: OFFSET
description: Returns a reference offset from a starting reference by a number of rows and columns, optionally resized.

name: ODD
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest odd integer.

name: OCT2HEX
description: Converts an octal number to hexadecimal.

name: OCT2DEC
description: Converts an octal number to decimal.

name: OCT2BIN
description: Converts an octal number to binary.

name: NPV
description: Calculates the net present value of an investment based on a discount rate and a series of future payments.

name: NPER
description: Returns the number of periods for an investment based on periodic, constant payments and a constant interest rate.

name: NOW
description: Returns the serial number of the current date and time.

name: NOT
description: Reverses the logical value of its argument.

name: NORMSINV
description: Returns the inverse of the standard normal cumulative distribution.

name: NORMSDIST
description: Returns the standard normal cumulative distribution for a given z-score (legacy NORMSDIST).

name: NORMINV
description: Returns the inverse of the normal cumulative distribution for the specified mean and standard deviation.

name: NORMDIST
description: Returns the normal distribution for the specified mean and standard deviation.

name: NORM.S.INV
description: Returns the inverse of the standard normal cumulative distribution.

name: NORM.S.DIST
description: Returns the standard normal distribution, with a mean of zero and a standard deviation of one.

name: NORM.DIST
description: Returns the normal distribution for the specified mean and standard deviation.

name: NOMINAL
description: Converts an effective annual interest rate to a nominal rate.

name: NETWORKDAYS
description: Returns the number of whole working days between two dates, excluding weekends and holidays.

name: NEGBINOMDIST
description: Returns the negative binomial distribution (probability) for a given number of failures before a specified number of successes.

name: NEGBINOM.DIST
description: Returns the negative binomial distribution.

name: NA
description: Returns the error value #N/A.

name: N
description: Returns a value converted to a number.

name: MULTINOMIAL
description: Returns the multinomial of a set of numbers.

name: MROUND
description: Returns a number rounded to the desired multiple.

name: MONTH
description: Returns the month of a date represented by a serial number (1-12).

name: MODE.SNGL
description: Returns the most frequently occurring value in a data set.

name: MODE
description: Returns the most frequently occurring value in a range or list of arguments.

name: MOD
description: Returns the remainder after a number is divided by a divisor; the result has the same sign as the divisor.

name: MINUTE
description: Returns the minute component of a time value, a number from 0 to 59.

name: MINIFS
description: Returns the minimum value among cells specified by a given set of conditions or criteria.

name: MIN
description: Returns the smallest value in a set of numbers.

name: MIDB
description: Returns a specific number of characters from a text string, starting at the position you specify, counted in bytes.

name: MID
description: Returns a specific number of characters from a text string, starting at the position you specify.

name: MEDIAN
description: Returns the median (the middle value) of the given numbers.

name: MAXIFS
description: Returns the maximum value among cells specified by a set of conditions.

name: MAX
description: Returns the largest value in a set of numbers.

name: MATCH
description: Returns the relative position of an item in a range that matches a specified value.

name: LOWER
description: Converts text to lowercase.

name: LOG10
description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

name: LOG
description: Returns the logarithm of a number to the base you specify (default 10).

name: LN
description: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.

name: LENB
description: Returns the number of bytes used to represent the characters in a text string.

name: LEN
description: Returns the number of characters in a text string.

name: LEFTB
description: Returns the specified number of characters from the start of a text string, counted in bytes.

name: LEFT
description: Returns the first character or characters in a text string, based on the number of characters you specify.

name: LCM
description: Returns the least common multiple of integers.

name: LARGE
description: Returns the k-th largest value in a data set.

name: KURT
description: Returns the kurtosis of a data set.

name: ISTEXT
description: Checks whether a value is text, and returns TRUE or FALSE.

name: ISODD
description: Returns TRUE if the number is odd.

name: ISNUMBER
description: Checks whether a value is a number, and returns TRUE or FALSE.

name: ISNONTEXT
description: Returns TRUE if the value is not text.

name: ISNA
description: Returns TRUE if the value is the #N/A error; otherwise returns FALSE.

name: ISLOGICAL
description: Returns TRUE if the value is a logical value.

name: ISFORMULA
description: Returns TRUE if the reference is to a cell that contains a formula.

name: ISEVEN
description: Returns TRUE if the number is even.

name: ISERROR
description: Returns TRUE if the value is any error value except #N/A.

name: ISERR
description: Returns TRUE if the value is any error value except #N/A.

name: ISBLANK
description: Returns TRUE if the value is blank.

name: IRR
description: Returns the internal rate of return for a series of cash flows.

name: IPMT
description: Returns the interest payment for a given period of an investment.

name: INTRATE
description: Returns the interest rate for a fully invested security.

name: INTERCEPT
description: Returns the intercept of the linear regression line through the known x and y values.

name: INT
description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

name: INDIRECT
description: Returns the reference specified by a text string.

name: INDEX
description: Returns the value of the element at the given row and column of a table or range.

name: IMTANH
description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of a complex number supplied as text.

name: IMTAN
description: Returns the tangent of a complex number.

name: IMSUM
description: Returns the sum of complex numbers.

name: IMSUB
description: Returns the difference between two complex numbers.

name: IMSINH
description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

name: IMSIN
description: Returns the sine of a complex number.

name: IMSEC
description: Returns the secant of a complex number.

name: IMREAL
description: Returns the real coefficient of a complex number given as text.

name: IMPRODUCT
description: Returns the product of complex numbers.

name: IMLOG2
description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of a complex number given as text.

name: IMLOG10
description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a complex number.

name: IMLN
description: Returns the natural logarithm of a complex number given as text.

name: IMEXP
description: Returns the exponential of a complex number given as text.

name: IMDIV
description: Returns the quotient of two complex numbers.

name: IMCSC
description: Returns the cosecant of a complex number provided as text.

name: IMCOT
description: Returns the cotangent of a complex number supplied as text.

name: IMCOSH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a complex number provided as text.

name: IMCOS
description: Returns the cosine of a complex number supplied as text.

name: IMCONJUGATE
description: Returns the complex conjugate of a complex number given as text.

name: IMAGINARY
description: Returns the imaginary coefficient of a complex number given as text.

name: IMABS
description: Returns the absolute value (modulus) of a complex number given as text.

name: IFS
description: Checks whether one or more conditions are met and returns the value that corresponds to the first TRUE condition.

name: IFNA
description: Returns a value you specify if the expression resolves to #N/A; otherwise returns the result of the expression.

name: IFERROR
description: Returns a value you specify if a formula evaluates to an error; otherwise returns the result of the formula.

name: IF
description: Returns one value if a condition is TRUE and another value if it is FALSE.

name: HYPERLINK
description: Creates a link that opens a web page, a file, or a place in this workbook. The cell shows friendly_name, or the link itself when it is omitted.

name: HOUR
description: Converts a serial number to an hour.

name: HLOOKUP
description: Looks in the top row of a table and returns the value in the same column from a row you specify.

name: HEX2OCT
description: Converts a hexadecimal number to octal.

name: HEX2DEC
description: Converts a hexadecimal number to decimal.

name: HEX2BIN
description: Converts a hexadecimal number to binary.

name: HARMEAN
description: Returns the harmonic mean of a data set.

name: GESTEP
description: Tests whether a number is greater than or equal to a threshold value, returning 1 if so and 0 otherwise.

name: GEOMEAN
description: Returns the geometric mean of an array or range of positive numbers.

name: GCD
description: Returns the greatest common divisor of two or more integers.

name: GAMMALN.PRECISE
description: Returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function.

name: GAMMALN
description: Returns the natural logarithm of the Gamma function, Γ(number).

name: GAMMADIST
description: Returns the gamma distribution.

name: GAMMA
description: Returns the Gamma function value for a number.

name: GAMMA.DIST
description: Returns the gamma distribution.

name: FV
description: Returns the future value of an investment based on periodic, constant payments and a constant interest rate.

name: FORMULATEXT
description: Returns the formula at the given reference as text.

name: FORECAST
description: Returns a value along a linear trend fitted to known x and y values.

name: FLOOR
description: Rounds a number down, toward zero, to the nearest multiple of significance.

name: FIXED
description: Rounds a number to the specified number of decimals and returns it as text, with or without thousands separators.

name: FISHERINV
description: Returns the inverse of the Fisher transformation.

name: FISHER
description: Returns the Fisher transformation of a value.

name: FINDB
description: Returns the position of one text string within another (case-sensitive), counting bytes for double-byte characters.

name: FIND
description: Returns the position of one text string within another (case-sensitive).

name: FDIST
description: Returns the right-tailed F probability distribution, the degree of diversity between two data sets.

name: FALSE
description: Returns the logical value FALSE.

name: FACTDOUBLE
description: Returns the double factorial of a number.

name: FACT
description: Returns the factorial of a number.

name: F.DIST
description: Returns the F probability distribution.

name: EXPONDIST
description: Returns the exponential distribution.

name: EXPON.DIST
description: Returns the exponential distribution.

name: EXP
description: Returns e raised to the power of a given number.

name: EXACT
description: Checks whether two text strings are exactly the same (case-sensitive).

name: EVEN
description: Rounds a number up, away from zero, to the nearest even integer.

name: EOMONTH
description: Returns the serial number of the last day of the month before or after a specified number of months.

name: EFFECT
description: Returns the effective annual interest rate, given the nominal annual rate and the number of compounding periods per year.

name: EDATE
description: Returns the serial number of the date that is the indicated number of months before or after the start date.

name: DOLLAR
description: Converts a number to text using currency format, with a dollar sign, thousands separators, and the specified number of decimals.

name: DISC
description: Returns the discount rate for a security.

name: DEVSQ
description: Returns the sum of squares of deviations of data points from their sample mean.

name: DELTA
description: Tests whether two numbers are equal, returning 1 if they are and 0 otherwise.

name: DEGREES
description: Converts radians to degrees.

name: DEC2OCT
description: Converts a decimal number to octal.

name: DEC2HEX
description: Converts a decimal number to hexadecimal.

name: DEC2BIN
description: Converts a decimal number to binary.

name: DDB
description: Returns the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the double-declining balance method or another method you specify.

name: DB
description: Returns the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the fixed-declining balance method.

name: DAYS360
description: Returns the number of days between two dates based on a 360-day year.

name: DAYS
description: Returns the number of days between two dates.

name: DAY
description: Returns the day of the month (1–31) from a date.

name: DATEDIF
description: Calculates the number of days, months, or years between two dates.

name: DATE
description: Returns the serial number of a particular date.

name: CUMPRINC
description: Returns the cumulative principal paid on a loan between two periods.

name: CUMIPMT
description: Returns the cumulative interest paid on a loan between two periods.

name: CSC
description: Returns the cosecant of an angle given in radians.

name: COVARIANCE.S
description: Returns the sample covariance, the average of the products of deviations for each data point pair in two data sets.

name: COVARIANCE.P
description: Returns the population covariance, the average of the products of deviations for each data point pair in two data sets.

name: COVAR
description: Returns the population covariance, the average of the products of paired deviations. Kept for compatibility with earlier versions; use COVARIANCE.P.

name: COUPPCD
description: Returns the previous coupon date before the settlement date.

name: COUPNUM
description: Returns the number of coupons payable between the settlement date and the maturity date.

name: COUPNCD
description: Returns the next coupon date after the settlement date.

name: COUNTIFS
description: Counts the number of cells that meet multiple criteria across one or more ranges.

name: COUNTIF
description: Counts the number of cells within a range that meet the given condition.

name: COUNTBLANK
description: Counts the number of empty cells in a specified range of cells.

name: COUNTA
description: Counts the number of cells that are not empty.

name: COUNT
description: Counts how many numbers are in the list of supplied arguments.

name: COTH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of a number.

name: COT
description: Returns the cotangent of an angle (in radians).

name: COSH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a number.

name: COS
description: Returns the cosine of a given angle (in radians).

name: CORREL
description: Returns the correlation coefficient between two data sets.

name: CONCATENATE
description: Joins several text items into one text string.

name: CONCAT
description: Joins the text from multiple values or ranges into a single string.

name: COMPLEX
description: Returns a complex number as text given real and imaginary coefficients and an optional suffix.

name: COMBIN
description: Returns the number of combinations for a given number of items.

name: COLUMNS
description: Returns the number of columns in an array or reference.

name: COLUMN
description: Returns the column number of a reference.

name: CODE
description: Returns the numeric code of the first character in a text string.

name: CLEAN
description: Removes all nonprintable characters from text.

name: CHOOSE
description: Uses an index number to pick one value from a list of values.

name: CHISQ.DIST.RT
description: Returns the right-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

name: CHISQ.DIST
description: Returns the left-tailed probability of the chi-squared distribution.

name: CHAR
description: Returns the character specified by a code number (1-255).

name: CEILING
description: Rounds a number up, away from zero, to the nearest multiple of significance.

name: BLOCKREFS
description: Fetches block cell values whose key and field matches conditions

name: BLOCKREF
description: Fetches a block cell value through its key and field

name: BITXOR
description: Performs a bitwise XOR operation on two integer values and returns the result.

name: BITRSHIFT
description: Shifts bits of a number to the right by a specified number of positions.

name: BITOR
description: Performs a bitwise OR operation on two integer values and returns the result.

name: BITLSHIFT
description: Shifts bits of a number to the left by a specified number of positions.

name: BITAND
description: Performs a bitwise AND operation on two integer values and returns the result.

name: BINOMDIST

name: BINOM.INV
description: Returns the smallest value for which the cumulative binomial distribution is greater than or equal to a criterion value.

name: BINOM.DIST
description: Returns the individual term binomial distribution probability.

name: BIN2OCT
description: Converts a binary number to octal.

name: BIN2HEX
description: Converts a binary number to hexadecimal.

name: BIN2DEC
description: Converts a binary number to decimal.

name: AVERAGEIFS
description: Returns the average of cells that meet multiple criteria.

name: AVERAGEIF
description: Returns the average of the cells in a range that meet the given condition.

name: AVERAGE
description: Returns the average (arithmetic mean) of the supplied numbers.

name: AVEDEV
description: Returns the average of the absolute deviations of data points from their mean.

name: ATANH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number.

name: ATAN2
description: Returns the arctangent of the specified x- and y-coordinates, in radians in the range -pi to pi (excluding -pi).

name: ATAN

name: ASINH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number.

name: ASIN
description: Returns the arcsine, or inverse sine, of a number. The result is in radians.

name: AND
description: Returns TRUE if all of its arguments are TRUE, and FALSE if any argument is FALSE.

name: AGGREGATE

name: ADDRESS
description: Creates a cell reference as text, given the row and column numbers.

name: ACOSH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number. The number must be greater than or equal to 1. The inverse hyperbolic cosine is the value whose hyperbolic cosine is number, so ACOSH(COSH(number)) equals number.

name: ACOS
description: Returns the arccosine, or inverse cosine, of a number. The arccosine is the angle whose cosine is number. The returned angle is given in radians in the range 0 (zero) to pi.

name: ACCRINTM
description: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays interest at maturity.

name: ACCRINT
description: Returns the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest.

name: ABS
description: Returns the absolute value of a number. The absolute value of a number is the number without its sign.
